id: title:adboio:put github repos and cloud defaults first in onboarding

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop client onboarding and GitHub CLI gating for repository selection, preserving discoverability while preventing failed PR creation.
review.reason: The chunk contains a conservative grouping of desktop onboarding and GitHub CLI gating. P1.F1, P1.F2, and P1.F3 demonstrate substantive implementation changes: P1.F1 adds GitHub CLI status-dependent gating and keeps the action visible but disabled; P1.F2 changes the return type to distinguish routine states from environment gaps; P1.F3 updates the compute call to use the new gate.
review.uncertainty: The chunk also includes P1.F7, P1.F8, P1.F9, P1.F12, and P1.F13, which are dominated by Storybook stories, minor exports, or lack the full GitHub-specific implementation body. While P1.F12 and P1.F13 show state and picker additions, the complete implementation and validation are not supplied. The tier is assigned based on the conservative grouping of the desktop onboarding and CLI,

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative grouping of desktop onboarding and GitHub CLI gating changes. No adoption, incident, or benefit is inferred. No tier is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds GitHub CLI status-dependent gating and keeps the 'create-pr' action visible but disabled when gh is missing or unauthenticated, while still allowing the action to appear in the menu.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop users with local Git changes can still see the GitHub CLI setup and PR creation option, but the action is disabled until gh is installed and authenticated; this preserves discoverability while preventing failed PR creation.

observations.behavior: Changes the return type of getCreatePrDisabledReason to include a visibility flag, distinguishing between routine states that hide the action and environment gaps that keep it visible.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the desktop client to distinguish between a PR that already exists (action hidden) and a missing GitHub CLI setup (action shown but disabled), supporting recovery and clearer UX.

observations.behavior: Updates the computeGitInteractionState call to use the new gate object and its reason, while retaining the disabled reason for display.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves backward compatibility while adopting the new gating structure; no change to the reason string, only the caller and its use of the gate object.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by Storybook story and component export changes, and several hunks are missing their actual implementation changes.
